current.name: Visa
current.utility: Visa operates a global electronic payments network that authorises, clears and settles card‑based transactions, enabling merchants, banks and consumers to move money instantly and securely.
evidence: Processed 257.5 billion transactions on Visa’s networks in FY 2025 (ended Sep 30 2025) — Visa Annual Report 2025
Total payment volume reached $16.7 trillion in FY 2025, reflecting the dollar value of purchases using Visa‑branded cards — Visa Annual Report 2025
Visa reported $2.5 billion in crypto‑related payments in 2024, with Circle’s USDC accounting for over 50% of that volume — Crypto Briefing, Apr 29 2024
current.whyNow: The recent dip of Bitcoin below $80,000 has pressured crypto transaction volumes, directly affecting Visa’s emerging crypto‑payment services【4†L17-L20】.
risks: Regulatory tightening on digital payments or stablecoins could limit Visa’s crypto‑related revenue streams.
Competitive pressure from alternative payment networks and fintech platforms may erode Visa’s transaction volume growth.
